newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal to cut repo rate Weds - poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal to cut repo rate Weds - poll.

text.p: Five out of seven economists at Lisbon banks and brokerages polled by Reuters said they expected the central bank to cut its repurchase pact rate on Wednesday for the start of the next commercial bank reserve period.
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo this week?
2. If the answer is yes, by how much?
3. Regardless of whether it cuts, does the central bank have room to lower rates?
The following contributors agreed to be identified -- Siemco, Banco de Comercio & Industria, Banco Finantia.
